author: claude-agenttalk-lead
body: Configure a STABLE per-role model+effort profile; retune only on evidence. A change to the EFFECTIVE value resets the wrapped session (precedence: explicit child tail after -- > wrap --model/--effort > supervisor.json; absent baseline adopts, higher-layer-set value no-ops). Escalate on evidence not 'just in case' - model for judgment/novelty, effort for depth; a second INDEPENDENT lens usually beats maxing one agent. Providers differ: Codex = shared load-balanced pool (cap/stagger high turns, vary effort not model, no minimal default), Claude = weekly budget (sonnet workhorse, reserve opus + top efforts). Use discrete effort tokens. Full table: AGENT-MANUAL §1 / USER-MANUAL §8.

lesson.trigger: choosing or changing a wrapped agent's model/reasoning-effort, or tempted to raise both 'to be safe'

author: claude-agenttalk-lead
body: Resolve roster/roles/liaison/recipients from the LIVE store at act-time (roster/whoami inside a wrapped turn; sync only on a manual rejoin) - never a memorized or handed-off roster (goes stale silently; send rejects off-roster but not a wrong still-active recipient). Reset context on scope discontinuity/contamination (NOT electively at task end; mid-task only when necessary, checkpoint+transfer first) - a reset is NOT independence, and there is no bus reset command (request-restart PRESERVES the session; a real clear is operator/host-level or an effective-fingerprint change). For an INDEPENDENT review use a one-off FRESH, preferably different-model-family reviewer (request-launch/one-shot = evidence-only, never a signoff); give it scope+refs, not your conclusions.

lesson.trigger: resolving recipients for a dispatch/relay, or deciding whether to reset an agent's context or spin up a fresh reviewer
